## Description

Treats bond yield curves as continuous functions over maturities, applying Functional Principal Component Analysis (FPCA) to extract infinite-dimensional functional eigenfunctions for yield curve forecasting.

## Where it may fit

Sovereign bond arbitrage, interest rate swap curve trading, monetary policy transition forecasting.

## Vehicles

Fixed Income Arbitrage Desks, Global Macro Funds.

## Required data

Multi-tenor daily sovereign bond yield curves and swap rate matrices.

## Caveats

Smoothing spline basis choices impact the stability of derivative eigenfunctions.
